# ghost/open-food-facts

Search public food products and read native Nutri-Score and nutrient levels, without camera or account

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/open-food-facts
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/open-food-facts open --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/open-food-facts search --device <serial> --param query=<query>
ghost skill run ghost/open-food-facts read_results --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/open-food-facts open_product --device <serial> --param index=<index>
ghost skill run ghost/open-food-facts read_nutrients --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/open-food-facts back_to_results --device <serial>
```

## Actions

- `open`: Open anonymous product search with camera denied
- `search`: Search public food products by name
- `read_results`: Read complete visible product cards and Nutri-Scores
- `open_product`: Open a visible product card and read its Nutri-Score
- `read_nutrients`: Read the visible product nutrient-level rows
- `back_to_results`: Return from nutrient levels or product to search results
